name: NuDoubt++
summary: NuDoubt++ proposes a detector for rare positron-emitting double weak decays, including standard two-neutrino modes and lepton-number-violating neutrinoless modes. Its primary example isotope is krypton-78.
detection_principle: A hybrid slow and opaque scintillator separates Cherenkov and scintillation light while localizing energy deposits near wavelength-shifting fibres. Positron annihilation topology provides additional background rejection.

status.label: Research and development
status.evidence: The publication presents detector concepts, R&D and sensitivity forecasts. Its tonne-week discovery prospects are not an observed two-neutrino double-beta-plus signal.

results.summary: The publication presents detector concepts, R&D and sensitivity forecasts. Its tonne-week discovery prospects are not an observed two-neutrino double-beta-plus signal.

science_scope: A neutrinoless decay would violate lepton number. Half-life sensitivity is a forecast unless explicitly reported as an experimental limit; its interpretation as an effective Majorana mass depends on the decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements.
